title: Explain flag on scored/ranked tools
description:
Sutra returns opaque scores in many tools: health scores (1.0-10.0), pr_risk (0.0-1.0), convention confidence, FCA thresholds, map importance ranking, impact risk levels. Agents and humans can't tell why a file scored 4.2 or why pr_risk is 0.7.

Add an `explain` parameter to scored tools that expands the scoring rationale:
- sutra_file_health → per-finding deduction breakdown, category cap effects, which biomarkers drove the score
- sutra_pr_risk → per-signal contribution (blast_radius, complexity, churn, volume)
- sutra_map → importance contributors (fan_in, symbol_count, blast_radius)
- sutra_impact → BFS frontier visible (which symbols at depth 1, 2, 3)
- sutra_review → risk_score decomposition

MCP-first. Default behavior (no flag) unchanged.

Replaces old task: sutra/3.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each of the 5 tools (sutra_file_health, sutra_pr_risk, sutra_map, sutra_impact, sutra_review) accepts an `explain: bool` parameter (default false)
When explain=false or absent, output is identical to today — no behavioral change
When explain=true, each tool adds an `_explain` object to the response with scoring rationale specific to that tool
file_health explain: formula text, per-finding raw_deduction + scale_factor, per-category cap + whether capping applied, biomarker weight table
pr_risk explain: normalization ceilings per signal, per-signal contribution (weight*score), per-symbol formula breakdown
map explain: per-file importance_breakdown showing each addend, formula text
impact explain: BFS frontier by depth (symbols at depth 1, 2, 3), threshold constants
review explain: weights with rationale (like pr_risk already has), per-signal ceiling + contribution
All existing tests pass unchanged (explain defaults off)
At least one integration test per tool exercises explain=true and asserts the _explain key is present and non-empty

execution_record: Implemented as planned — 8 steps collapsed to one commit. All 5 tools got `explain: Option<bool>` in their Args struct, threaded through handle/compute. The `_explain` object uses underscore prefix matching the existing `_meta` convention. Test file `tests/explain-test.rs` covers all 5 tools (positive + negative). Full suite (392+ tests) passes clean.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review (verdict: needs-attention):

1. [medium] pr_risk omits _explain for empty diffs — compute() returns early when changed_paths.is_empty() before the explain block. explain=true on a no-op range silently drops _explain.
2. [medium] review omits _explain for empty diffs — same early-return pattern in review::compute(). Clean branches/empty ranges bypass the explain block.
3. [medium] review hotspot ceiling is string "file_count (dynamic)" not the actual numeric ceiling used — consumers can't recompute contribution from the explanation. Test masks this by allowing string|number.
